name: Pipeliners - City Sewer Lining Videos Plan 2026-10-15
body:
> Plan · Pipeliners · 2026-10-15

# Summary
Planning doc for short city-specific sewer lining videos. Status: planning, nothing generated. Next step was Kim approving the Mesa script, then storyboard sketches.

# Brief (Kim's choices)
- Process shown: sewer lining only (camera, hydro jet, liner in, cure, camera check).
- Local part fully unique per city (house style, scenery, main problem, one real local fact).
- AI voiceover with burned-in captions; 9:16 vertical, about 30 seconds.
- Ending: Pipeliners logo and "Book a camera inspection", with no phone number (protects call tracking).
- Review flow: script, sketch frames, finished video. Kim approves scripts. Rollout Mesa first, then 3-5 cities by GSC demand.

# Defaults (to confirm)
HyperFrames animated cutaway, clean 2D light style with navy #1a446f accents, Arizona look only, YouTube Shorts on the PipelinersUSA channel plus a city page embed (a separate page edit needing its own OK). The liner access method is not named.

# Content rules
"Pipeliners" only; no "pipe lining"/"pipelining" nouns, "pipeline" or "pigging"; claims limited to no digging, 50+ year liner, 20-year warranty and camera footage before quoting; never #1/best, 24/7, same day, prices, pipe bursting, repipes or competitors; no em dashes; local facts only from the live city page or the Oct 2 city audit.

# Mesa script draft
About 70 words over six shots: roots cracking an old line under a mid-century Mesa ranch, camera footage, hydro jetting, liner in and curing, final camera pass with the yard untouched, close card ("Designed for 50+ years, with a 20-year warranty. Pipeliners, based in Mesa.").
